name: apigency-hourly-earnings
description: Hourly earnings tracker for freelancers and contractors: start, pause and finish client work, and report what was earned.

interface.longDescription:
APIgency Hourly Earnings connects ChatGPT to Workday.Money, an earnings and client-work tool for freelancers and contractors who bill by the hour. Each client project has its own hourly rate, and earnings grow as work runs. ChatGPT can manage the user's own client projects, start, pause and finish client work, use project rates, set billable limits, mark work as unpaid, and report earnings from completed records.

Finishing a task records the completed work in Workday.Money, and that record never changes afterwards. If the project has a connected, writable Google Sheet, a copy is also sent there. Reports are built from the records in Workday.Money.

The plugin can create projects with a currency and later change their name, rate, or reporting period; archive and restore projects; cap billable time; mark work unpaid; move unfinished tasks between projects; and trim forgotten time. Trimming only reduces the accumulated time of an unfinished task, and the task must be paused first. Time can never be added.

The assistant cannot sign in as the user, make payments, or delete the account or projects. It can delete an unfinished task together with its still-unrecorded time.

Timers run on the server, not in the chat. Ending the conversation does not stop them; a task stops when it is paused or finished.

A Workday.Money account is required; sign-in happens on workday.money.

Workday.Money is an independent product and is not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by Workday, Inc.
defaultPrompt: What am I working on right now?
Start a task called "Weekly sync" on my first project.
How much did I earn in the last 30 days?

positive.prompt: Show my Workday.Money projects with their rates.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the account's active projects with each project's hourly rate and currency.

positive.prompt: Start a task called "Review call" on my first project.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the first project and starts a running task named Review call on it, then confirms the task is running.
Shows the running and paused tasks with their projects and the time and amount accumulated so far.

positive.prompt: How much did I earn in September 2026?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports recorded earnings and hours for September 2026, broken down by project and currency.

positive.prompt: Pause the "Review call" task, then finish it.
positive.expected_behavior: Pauses the task, asks for confirmation before finishing because finishing records the work permanently, then finishes it and reports the recorded time and amount.

negative.prompt: What is the weather in Paris today?

negative.description: Creative writing with no tracking intent
negative.prompt: Write a short poem about autumn.

negative.description: Currency conversion unrelated to the user's records

publication.release_notes: First release: track hourly client work and report earnings from ChatGPT.
